title: Filesystem MCP server (reference implementation)
summary: The reference Filesystem MCP server, as identified in AVE-2026-0005. The sources establish only that it writes files.

evidence.note: The chain uses the Filesystem MCP server to write a script and to write to Git's internal config files.
The Filesystem MCP server is used to write to a .git/config file.

unknown.note: It can read files, but whether they are private depends on the directories it is granted; the sources do not describe the grants.
Only if the granted directories include the agent's own configuration. Not established by the sources.
